comment: One map from a symptom to the page that tells you what to do about it. Alerts reach a runbook through runbook_url in alerts.yml; an operator staring at an error in the Control Center reaches the same page through error_codes. Two maps would drift, and the half nobody maintains is the half someone needs at 3am.

siem.name: SIEM (QRadar)
siem.degrades_to: Findings stay queued in the outbox. Detection continues; delivery does not.

model_endpoint.name: LLM endpoint
model_endpoint.degrades_to: Reasoning stages return the error verdict. Triage and posture rules keep working, so the platform is partially blind rather than blind.

analysis_worker.name: ADR analysis workers
analysis_worker.degrades_to: Sessions accumulate in the queue at ingested. Nothing is lost; everything is late.

engine.name: umai-engine
engine.degrades_to: Guardrail evaluation fails closed. This is the one dependency whose loss blocks rather than delays.

database.name: Database
database.degrades_to: Everything stops. The service reports unready and ingest is rejected rather than dropped.

transcript_store.name: Transcript volume
transcript_store.degrades_to: Sessions are recorded without content. Findings are still raised; their evidence is missing.

redis.name: Redis
redis.degrades_to: Cold cache and per-process rate limiting. Nothing durable is lost, because nothing durable is kept there.
